name: Arena Hazards
description: The arena's hostile set dressing on a schedule: crushers that sweep, floor sections that drop, lava that rises. It owns hazard scripts—which hazard volumes warn, arm, disarm, or mutate, and how pressure escalates—but never boss win rules, contact, damage, or timed status effects. Legacy phaseScript, automatic intervals, and escalation remain unchanged by default. Optional arenas add boss-driven activation: bossEngaged selects the initial hazardPhase, bossPhaseChanged and bossEnraged select declared later phases, and completion, failure, or reset disarms the script. Warning and arm timing come from Timer System. Hazard Volume instances alone report contact; Arena Hazards does not convert contact into a hit. Restored arena state resumes current phase, warnings, armed volumes, and timers without emitting historical warning, trigger, or reset events.

inputs.name: phaseScript
inputs.description: Legacy ordered phases: which hazard ids arm, disarm, or mutate per phase. Used with automatic activation; empty when arenas supplies boss-driven arena scripts.

inputs.name: phaseIntervalSeconds
inputs.description: Base time between phases. Short enough that vehicle health totals outlast two or three phases, so hazards shape the fight rather than end it.

inputs.name: escalate
inputs.description: When true, later phases tighten intervals and widen hazard coverage. The escalation curve is what guarantees a match cannot stall forever.

inputs.name: activationMode
inputs.description: automatic preserves the legacy interval script. bossDriven waits for bossEngaged and follows matching boss phase/enrage hazardPhase ids until completion, failure, or reset.

inputs.name: arenas
inputs.description: Boss-driven definitions: [{id, hazards:[{id, regions, damage, retriggerSeconds, instantlyLethal}], phases:[{id, warningSeconds?, arm?, disarm?, mutate?}]}]. Hazard and phase ids are stable within an arena; boss encounters reference them rather than embedding volume behavior.

inputs.name: initialState
inputs.description: Restored active arena, phase, pending warnings, armed volumes, mutations, and timer ids. Restoration emits no historical arena events.

outputs.name: activeHazardCount
outputs.description: Armed hazard volumes right now. HUD warning lights and audio tension both read this rather than tracking volumes themselves.

outputs.name: currentPhaseId
outputs.description: Stable active hazard phase id, or null while disarmed. Numeric currentPhase remains for legacy consumers.

outputs.name: activeHazards
outputs.description: Currently armed hazard records and pending warnings with stable hazard and timer ids; together with currentPhaseId this is the boss-driven restorable state.

outputs.name: lastRejected
outputs.description: Why a boss phase, warning, or timer completion was ignored, including stale encounter ids and unknown hazard phases.
